result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there are a few visual problems: the promotional banner text has very poor contrast (white text on a pale green background), a category chip on the right edge is cut off with no visible label, and a restaurant name in the horizontal carousel is truncated. The bottom pizza card is also clipped mid-image by the navigation bar.

issues.description: The promo banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is white/very light on a pale mint-green background, making it nearly unreadable and failing WCAG contrast requirements.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color (e.g., dark green or near-black) on the light green banner, or darken the banner background so the white text has at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.description: A category filter chip on the far right of the chip row ('Healthy' row) is cut off at the screen edge with no visible text, appearing as an empty pill fragment.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontally scrollable chip list shows a partial chip with visible label text, or adjust padding/peek width so truncated chips still hint at their content.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated abruptly at the screen edge without an ellipsis, and the card is partially clipped.
issues.suggestion: Apply text ellipsis within the card width rather than letting text run to the viewport edge, or adjust carousel item peek so truncation looks intentional.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is clipped mid-image by the bottom navigation bar, with no visible restaurant details, making it look abruptly cut.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/scroll inset below the last content section so cards are not obscured by the fixed bottom navigation, or fade the content behind the nav bar.
